speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I understand you are experiencing sudden-onset lower back pain radiating down your leg. To help me identify the cause, could you tell me how long you have had these symptoms and on which side of your body the pain is located?

speaker: Patient
text: 26-year-old woman. The patient reports exercising in the gym several hours ago when she suddenly felt a sharp pain in her lower back. She describes the pain as radiating down the side of her leg and into her foot.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Lumbar Radiculopathy (likely L5 or S1 nerve root compression, potentially due to an acute disc herniation or muscle strain given the sudden onset during exercise).

Do you have any numbness, tingling, or weakness in your leg or foot, and does coughing or sneezing worsen the pain?
